# Purpose

This is a starter Quarto report demonstrating the pattern: a partner-facing
deliverable that **cites findings by id** and re-runs from source. Each
finding link points at the canonical markdown under `docs/findings/`;
the underlying claims are evidence-backed and survive session restart
(see [README](../findings/README.md) for the schema).

# Current findings (snapshot)

As of the last build, three findings are active. The canonical list lives
in [`docs/findings/INDEX.md`](../findings/INDEX.md). Highlights:

- **[2026-05-28-test-prefix-empty](../findings/2026-05-28-test-prefix-empty.md)** —
  Audit of the last 100 commits found zero `test:` / `test(qa):` prefixes
  despite ~18k lines of test code. CLAUDE.md now encodes the convention.

- **[2026-05-28-error-attribution-framework](../findings/2026-05-28-error-attribution-framework.md)** —
  Proposed replacement for the scalar `scoreErrorRisk()`: event-sourced
  error ledger + per-slice Bayesian weights + causal DAG. Substantive;
  not yet implemented.

- **[2026-05-28-evidence-ledger-architecture](../findings/2026-05-28-evidence-ledger-architecture.md)** —
  Meta-finding: rationale and tooling choices behind this very ledger
  (Datasette + DVC + Quarto + gbrain).

# How to regenerate

```bash
make findings   # rebuild findings.db (canonical: docs/findings/*.md)
make report     # render this report to HTML in _output/
make report-pdf # same, to PDF
```

# Adding live data queries (optional)

This starter renders as pure markdown. To embed live `findings.db` queries
(SQL or Python) inside a report, install Jupyter into a venv and use a
Quarto Python code block:

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv-reports
source .venv-reports/bin/activate
pip install jupyter pyyaml
# then in the .qmd: ```{python} ... ```
```

Or use Quarto's built-in SQL engine to query `findings.db` directly without
Python. See [Quarto docs — SQL](https://quarto.org/docs/computations/sql.html).

# How to add a new finding to cite here

1. Copy `docs/findings/_template.md` → `docs/findings/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md`
2. Fill in frontmatter (id, date, scope, evidence — every claim cited)
3. Append a one-liner to `docs/findings/INDEX.md`
4. Add a `[link text](../findings/your-slug.md)` reference above
5. `make findings && make report` to rebuild
